timing.note: The end-to-end clock includes diagnosis, implementation and hot validation of the MCP draft bug plus the hanging Playwright MCP transport. The post-fix continuation started with a proven backend and is not a full clean-run benchmark.

backend.avoidableDebt: list.pairRows and the rows output are left over but unused by the final frontend.

toolingFindings.finding: frontend-svelte-code-check/set projected the persisted file instead of the supplied draft because the MCP block sent drafts instead of frontendSourceDrafts.
toolingFindings.impact: An invalid candidate could be written after the old valid source passed validation; subsequent source tools could not recover.
toolingFindings.resolution: Fixed and regression-tested in lib_flow_mcp c5dd995.

toolingFindings.finding: The picker does not expose an iteration index binding.
toolingFindings.impact: The agent created list.withAlternatingFlag to implement alternating cards.

toolingFindings.finding: Progress does not flag unused project-local blocks or unused backend outputs.
toolingFindings.impact: list.pairRows and result.rows survived although the final frontend does not consume them.

toolingFindings.finding: Playwright MCP navigation and follow-up calls hang after a successful production build.
toolingFindings.impact: Independent Playwright was required for browser proof.

comparison.interpretation: The intuitive source workflow reduced unit frontend mutations by 91%, but Run8 is not faster overall because it discovered and repaired a blocking draft-validation defect and again hit the Playwright MCP hang. The 13-call post-fix continuation shows the intended low-churn path but is not a clean full-run measurement.
